parsed.reason: Description A identifies a defect where the try block wraps the batch flush, so sink failures (SinkError) are misreported as malformed rows and batched valid rows are silently lost. Description B is about a behaviour change where malformed rows no longer abort the load and callers must inspect report.rejected. These are different failures: one is about sink errors being swallowed and data loss, the other is an intended API semantics change for bad input.
